output_policy: Native allowed_token_ids restricts each request to the first frozen non-EOS teacher token. This is not task accuracy.
scope: A stronger generic low-concurrency ready-work baseline. Do not compare constant-token trials directly to earlier changing-teacher trials.
request_independence: Two frozen calibration prompt shapes repeat within larger cohorts. Five repeats are not five independent request populations.
admission: C means submitted closed-cohort size. It does not assert that all requests enter one native iteration. Record actual membership in a separate trace lane.
separate_experiment: No adaptive CDB/refill or hindsight request-placement experiment is repeated.
